masonryAllWallsMin.quote: The facades for the building shall be constructed of 90% brick or a
masonryAllWallsMin.note: Brick, or a combination of brick and EIFS, counts toward the 90%.

notes: The hotel must be improved in accordance with the site plan, landscape plan, floor plan and facade plans in Exhibit A of 023-51, which adopts a new development plan for the existing hotel.

notes.heading: Special conditions
items: 023-51 lists only the plan condition and does not say whether the conditions below still apply.
On-site detention is required for stormwater runoff.
The site is in the 70 to 75 Ldn noise contours, so an avigation easement is required.
Before any development, plans must go to the FAA to check compliance with Addison's height hazard zoning.
Before a building permit and again on completion, a certified acoustical expert must verify the building meets 30 dB of outside-to-inside sound attenuation.
The north entrance must match up with the median opening in the proposed Arapaho Road and should be at least 36 ft wide.
Trees along Arapaho Road and Quorum Drive must follow the Town's streetscape plan for tree spacing.
The undeveloped open space west of the building must be irrigated and maintained with the rest of the site.
A detailed landscape and irrigation plan is required before a building permit.
The dumpster enclosure must be made of the same material as the building and be large enough for all dumpsters.
Mechanical equipment must be screened by a parapet wall or screening device that is architecturally compatible with the building.
The building and site must meet all fire code requirements.

notes.heading: Alcohol sales
items: Alcohol may be sold only in restaurants, meaning places that get at least 60% of gross revenue from food.
Bookkeeping records must be available to the Town for inspection.
Exterior signs may not advertise alcohol sales or use terms like "bar" or "tavern."
If the alcohol license or permit is revoked, terminated or canceled, the City Council may hold hearings on changing the zoning.
